title: Run detail page (/workflows/:id/runs/:runId)
description: Gantt-style timeline (Recharts) showing step execution, blocking time, and safety decisions. Step list with individual status. Chat/notes panel. Rerun and cancel actions.
definitionOfDone: Gantt-style timeline chart (Recharts) showing step execution timeline
Blocking time and safety decisions visible on timeline
Step list with individual status, duration, and safety info
DAG visualization embedded (from DAG Run Visualization task)
Rerun and cancel action buttons with confirmation

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/pages/RunDetailPage.tsx: Route /workflows/:id/runs/:runId. Uses useRun(runId) and useRunTimeline(runId). Layout: (1) Header: run ID, status badge, started/duration, workflow name link. (2) DAG visualization: RunVisualization component embedded showing live step status. (3) Gantt timeline: Recharts BarChart with horizontal bars per step showing start/end times, blocking time highlighted in different color, safety decision icons. (4) Step list: accordion/collapsible list of steps with individual status, duration, safety info, and error messages for failed steps. (5) Actions: Rerun button (useRerunRun), Cancel button (useCancelRun, only if running), both with ConfirmDialog.
implementationPlan.note: Full RunDetailPage: header with status/duration/link, DAG visualization (RunVisualization), Gantt timeline, expandable step list with safety badges and error display, Rerun/Cancel actions with ConfirmDialogs.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/GanttTimeline.tsx: Recharts-based Gantt chart component. Props: steps with start/end times. Horizontal bars per step, time axis at top. Color-coded by status. Blocking time (time between step end and next step start) shown as lighter bar. Safety decision markers as icons on the timeline.
implementationPlan.note: Recharts horizontal BarChart: stacked bars with blocking time (gray) + execution duration (status-colored). Custom tooltip with step name, status, duration, wait, safety. ResponsiveContainer with dynamic height.
